set.body:
Problem (edcdfd5): NamedHit(name, distanceDevicePx, drawOrder) carries no position (modules/interaction/.../NamedPicking.scala:9). RasterCell(row, column, value) is produced only by the plot compiler (modules/core/.../InteractionCompiler.scala:16, :276). An image grob in a hand-built scene therefore picks as one opaque name, and JavaFxInteractionView.named (JavaFxInteractionHost.scala:135-171) cannot report or navigate cells.

General use: heatmaps, design matrices and confusion matrices drawn as scenes. Consumer example: the PLS Neuro model studio design sheet (plsneuro main, docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md section 2.3) needs a hover readout and a selected column from a nearest-neighbour raster.

Acceptance:
- A hit on a named image grob reports (row, column) under a documented row-origin convention.
- Identical on JVM and JS; agrees with drawn pixel geometry under viewport scaling, clipping and rotation.
- JavaFxInteractionView exposes the cell for hover and selection; keyboard cell navigation optional.
- No change for other grobs.

Out of scope: value lookup (caller owns data); smooth interpolation.
Provenance: verified read-only 2026-10-08 for PLS Neuro review bd-01M4DMGP1QFSQX9Z5V91B4B12F (plsneuro store).
set.title: [Intaglio][Interaction] Report raster cell coordinates when picking named image grobs
